native_machine.modification: Native GTNH mixer ProcessingLogic and StructureLib integration around the separately licensed original MBS geometry. User-selected balance: fixed 6000% speed (duration divided by 60) and perfect overclocking (four times EU/t and duration divided by four per overclock). Preserve native energy/voltage protection and power-panel parallel control. These rates are local balance choices, not reconstructed closed GTOLib internals. Replace modern hatch predicates/client state with native equivalents; preserve source block mapping and black-hole location. Reuse existing Field Extruder fusion-reactor controller overlays with their existing attribution.

native_adapters.modification: Independent GTNH 1.7.10 block/item/StructureLib/CTM adapter. Original upstream art remains LGPL; native renderer supplies separately lit emissive overlays for the two active coils.
